description: Fetch a restaurant's menu: returns menu_id (needed for cart adds and item details), store_is_open, and items with item_id, name, description, price, category, has_required_modifiers, orderability. Large menus are capped — pass `filter` (case-insensitive substring on name/description/category) to narrow.

intent.description: One short line stating who this is for and the goal, e.g. 'Help the user order dinner'. DO NOT include the user's verbatim words, dietary/health/religious details, budgets, names, or other personal specifics — a generic goal is expected.

store_id.description: Store ID from search_restaurants or order history

name: get_menu
